description: Implementation of the PolicyService interface, providing CRUD-like operations for Policy entities within an insurance management system.

classes.name: PolicyServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing PolicyService for managing policy records.

methods.name: createPolicy
methods.description: Creates a new Policy with specified attributes if the code is unique.

methods.name: updatePremium
methods.description: Updates the base premium of an existing Policy identified by policyId.

methods.name: findByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a Policy by its unique code.

methods.name: findByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of policies matching a specific PolicyType.
